Title: Studio project scope conversation
Date: 2026-11-10
Type: Meeting
Collection: Studio
Author: Alex Morgan

Alex Morgan and Sam Chen met at Cedar Library to agree on the first Studio project prototype. They revisited the navigation sketch from November 3 and the reading reflections from November 8.

Alex and Sam agreed to start with a small reading space. The first prototype should make it easy to find a note and understand where it came from. Search results must link back to an original passage rather than presenting an unsupported summary.

Alex will prepare ten fictional text documents. Sam will review the document titles and collection labels. They provisionally planned a review for November 18 at 14:00, with the location still undecided. No backend service or cloud connection is part of this checkpoint.
